title: 10x XL Value Fantasi | 10ml Nic Salts Bundle
description:
Fantasi 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid Bundle Pack:
If you’re a fan of our Fantasi nic salt vape juices in 50/50 mix, then you’re going to love this bundle! We’ve combined our delicious nic salt flavors in Fantasi 10ml bottles so you can save money while stocking up on your absolute favorite E-liquids.
Cola Ice
:
Ice, cooled, and sparkling cola flavor ! Blue Raspberry Ice:
Delivers all the juicy and sweet notes of the raspberry but with an extra special cooling candy twist.
Grape Ice:
Fresh and delicious grapes have been supercooled in this iconic and refreshing flavor .
Wartermelon Ice:
Juicy, fruity, with refreshing watermelon notes, supercooled.
Blu Raspberry Cherry Ice:
All of the juicy and sweet flavours of raspberries, but with a distinctive candy twist.
Cherry Ice
:
Fresh and fruity, with a full rich palate of flavor is cooled and sweetened into a much-loved all-day vape.
Mango Ice
:
Bursting with authentic juicy, ripe mango flavor with our signature Fantasi sparkle chilled to perfection!
Orange Ice
:
Delivers beautifully with fresh, sweet and citrusy supercooled flavors
Black currant X Grape Apple:
Ripe, juicy blackberries intertwine with the distinctive flavor of succulent grapes and fresh, crisp apples.
Tropical X Thunder:
A tropical fusion of sweet and tangy fruit medley.
Fantasi Nic Salt E Liquids are perfect for people looking for a high nicotine dose without the unpleasant throat hit associated with higher-strength E Liquids. For the smoothest vape imaginable, Fantasi Salts are manufactured with 50% PG (Propylene Glycol) and 50% VG (Vegetable Glycerine). You can get yours in 10ml bottles with either 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength. Nic Salts perform best in devices with coils greater than 1ohm in resistance, such as POD Kits, Vape Pens, and Starter Kits. Because nicotine salt E-liquid is stronger and thinner than standard E-liquid, it is not recommended to use it in a Sub-ohm device.
Ingredients
Vegetable Glycerine (50%)
Propylene Glycol (50%)
Vapoholic Flavouring
Nicotine Salts

1x Cherry Ice Nic Salt
1x Blue Raspberry Cherry Ice Nic Salt
1x Mango Ice Nic Salt
1x Orance Ice Nic Salt
1x Blackcurrant X Grape Apple Nic Salt
1x Tropical X Thunder Nic Salt

50/50

Highlights:
10x best-selling Fantasi nic salt E-liquids for you to try!
Delicious flavours in a 50/50 mix for pod devices and vape starter kits
Perfect for flavoursome nicotine salt vaping
10 popular 10ml E-liquids bundled together to save you even more money!
